verdict.root_cause: At 08:09:16Z platform-automation updated cartservice's image reference to hotfix tag v1.2.1-cartservice-hotfix.2 [tr_61b2940ecbca]. cartservice logged an orderly application-shutdown at that same timestamp and emitted nothing for the rest of the window [tr_7bdd4aa1d794], meaning the replacement artifact never resumed serving. From then, every one of 10 failed checkout traces breaks at exactly one hop - checkoutservice's client span to CartService GetCart, the only erroring leaf, failing in 1.8-4.2ms, a fast refusal rather than a timeout [tr_56a493eeb70c]. checkoutservice logs show PlaceOrder starting and never reaching payment/email/queue steps, with no error lines of its own [tr_f68a63bd858c], and its error ratio steps up at a single change point at 08:10:45, ~90s after the image swap [tr_95ce63fc849e]. No change at all is recorded against checkoutservice [tr_93bb155447cf], and unlike the four earlier image-update cycles that day this one has no paired revert - it was the only change in effect at onset [tr_61b2940ecbca]. checkoutservice and frontend are propagating the failure, not causing it.
verdict.reasoning: Traces localize the origin to the checkoutservice->CartService GetCart edge and rule out the frontend, checkout's own preparation logic, and the unmeasured accounting/currency/payment edges since checkout aborts before those are attempted; sub-10ms durations also rule out timeout/latency exhaustion, which is what separates this from dependency_latency [tr_56a493eeb70c]. On the callee side, cartservice's stream ends with a lifecycle shutdown at the exact timestamp of the image update, with normal traffic right up to the last seconds - an abrupt stop, not saturation or a logged store fault [tr_7bdd4aa1d794]. Change history supplies the mechanism and excludes the other candidates: the REDIS_ADDR override and the 300ms traffic-shaping sidecar were both reverted 4.3-4.5h before onset [tr_61b2940ecbca]. checkoutservice itself has no changes [tr_93bb155447cf]. The wrongness is the artifact that is not running, not the value of a setting, so bad_deploy; restoring the prior image is the fix, as the earlier cycles did.
open_questions: No pod-level evidence: whether the hotfix image failed to pull, crash-looped, or exited at startup is inferred from log silence alone.

checkoutservice's error ratio averaged only ~0.077 with a minimum still at zero [tr_95ce63fc849e], hard to reconcile with cartservice being wholly absent; a partial rollout with surviving replicas or a client fallback would explain it but was not checked.

cartservice has no span-derived metrics under that label in either window [tr_e8c53092e54c], so its rate/error/latency could not be independently confirmed; frontend and loadgenerator were never dispatched to.

alternatives.root_cause: The hotfix image started fine but its configuration or startup environment is wrong, so it refuses GetCart calls.
alternatives.why_not: No config change was in effect at onset - REDIS_ADDR was reverted 4.3h earlier [tr_61b2940ecbca] - and the process emitted nothing after shutdown [tr_7bdd4aa1d794], so it is absence of a working artifact rather than a wrong value breaking requests.

alternatives.root_cause: checkoutservice itself began failing cart lookups internally around 08:10:45 for reasons unrelated to the cartservice deploy.
alternatives.why_not: The erroring span is checkout's outbound client call with near-zero self time in its parent, and the error propagates upward [tr_56a493eeb70c]; checkoutservice has no recorded change [tr_93bb155447cf] and logs no errors of its own [tr_f68a63bd858c].
